THE COURT ORDERS DISMISSAL OF THE ENTIRE ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF CHERYL LEGER. DEFENDANT SOPIKO KHARADZE APPEARED. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM LAUREN KRAMER SUJEETH, CLERK: A. MOK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
